Codebreakers Asset Studio

CODEBREAKERS · ASSET STUDIO

Every picture and animation in the game, with the file name to use if you want to replace one. Prompts are written to match the existing style, so new pictures fit in.

Swap it yourself (no Claude needed)

  1. Make or find the new picture. Use the copied prompt for a matching style.
  2. Rename the file to the name shown on its card, for example r3-fa.png.
  3. In your GitHub repo, create a folder called images (once) and upload the file into it.
  4. Refresh the game. The new picture replaces the built-in one. Delete the file to go back.

Or send it to Claude

  1. Attach the picture in the chat.
  2. Say which slot it is for, for example "this is for r3-fa".
  3. Claude builds it into the game file, so it works everywhere, including inside Claude.
  4. To change an animation, describe what you want, or send a GIF for that slot.

REAL HISTORY IMAGES

ANIMATIONS

Animations are pixel art drawn by code. A GIF in images/scene-SLOT.gif replaces one.
